broken_links.what: Flint 2 WAN port wired to JetStream but NOT sending frames
broken_links.impact: Right Ear can't join the mesh via wire — only WiFi bridge possible
theories: WAN interface DOWN in OpenWrt config
WAN configured as static IP on wrong subnet
JetStream port disabled or VLAN mismatch
Flint 2 in router mode with WAN port not initialized
fix_options: SSH into Flint 2 via IPv6 from southGate (when recovered) and check wan config
Kevin physically checks Flint 2 admin panel at 192.168.8.1 via browser on local device
Kevin plugs laptop/phone into Flint 2 LAN port, browses to 192.168.8.1

broken_links.what: southGate WiFi switched to Flint 2 + added 192.168.4.250/24 to wlp6s0
broken_links.impact: Reply packets to .244 routed through wlp6s0 (Flint 2 network) instead of enp4s0 (spine)
broken_links.self_healing: NetworkManager will eventually timeout Flint2 connection and reconnect to Aperture Science. Manual IP will be lost when interface cycles.
broken_links.force_fix: Kevin physically: 'sudo nmcli con down Flint2 && sudo nmcli con up Aperture_Science && sudo ip addr del 192.168.4.250/24 dev wlp6s0'
broken_links.trust: WILL RETURN. Time heals this one.

broken_links.fix: SSH to Flint 1 (.9) and reconfigure WDS client
